correctness.rationale: Forcing k candidate diameters separates their common crossing partners into k independent opposite-sector bijections, yielding the exact all-k factorial-moment sum with correct cyclic multiplicity n/k. Conditioning on a universal diameter gives uniform π in S_{n−1}; its crossing count is (n−1)+binom(n−1,2)−inv(π), and extra universal chords are singleton direct-sum blocks. Lehmer inversion coordinates independently yield the exact variance and Gaussian CLT, and the expected extra hubs given a marked hub is 2/(n−1)+O(n^−2), giving O(1/n) size-biased total-variation transfer. Direct checks in verify.py passed 311034 exact assertions across all n≤7 chord pairings and n≤8 conditional permutations, read directly from the package; finite tests do not prove asymptotics.

value.rationale: Universal-vertex existence is the natural far upper extreme of the degree distribution of random circle graphs. The complete simultaneous-hub law (rather than one-chord mean) distinguishes how often hubs coexist. The exact permutation representation under an exponentially rare extremal event produces a nontrivial density shift from 1/6 to 1/4 and a full conditional Gaussian fluctuation law, useful to graph rare-event sampling and structural extreme-degree models. This is not an arbitrary finite parameter slice or merely a normalization check.
